lyrics:
[Intro: choppy nylon guitar, dusty kick drum]

[Verse 1: raspy lazy male voice]
Got here early, put a towel on the chair
Next to mine, like you'd be there
Ordered two of everything, drank them slow
Told the waiter you're on your way. He knows.

[Chorus: four-on-the-floor, bass, voice doubled]
Towel on the chair, towel on the chair
Holding your place in the sun
I'm not waiting, I'm just here
In case you want to come
Towel on the chair

[Verse 2: voice and guitar, kick steady]
Kid cannonballed and soaked your side
I dried it off with mine
Sun moved round and I moved too
Dragged your shade along with you

[Chorus: four-on-the-floor, bass, voice doubled]
Towel on the chair, towel on the chair
Holding your place in the sun
I'm not waiting, I'm just here
In case you want to come
Towel on the chair

[Break: guitar alone, handclaps, hummed]
Mm, mm. It's a good chair.

[Final Chorus: full beat, a second voice humming]
Towel on the chair, towel on the chair
Holding your place in the sun
I'm not waiting, I'm just here
In case you want to come
Towel on the chair

[Outro: guitar chop fades, a glass set down]
producerBrief:
TEMPO / KEY / FEEL: 114 BPM, 4/4, C# minor. Loose, dusty and nodding, a folk song with a house heartbeat.

VOICE: Male, raspy and half-mumbled, sung low and lazily as if lying down. Doubled loosely in the choruses. He hums through the break.

INSTRUMENTS: A nylon-string acoustic guitar playing a short chopped figure, a soft thudding kick on every beat, an off-beat hi-hat, a rounded electric bass, handclaps, a little lo-fi organ.

ARRANGEMENT MAP: 0:00 Intro, guitar and kick. 0:16 Verse 1. 0:48 Chorus 1. 1:14 Verse 2. 1:46 Chorus 2. 2:12 Break, guitar and claps. 2:28 Final chorus. 2:54 Outro, guitar fades, a glass at 3:06.

PRODUCTION & MIX: Home-recorded warmth: slightly lo-fi, dry and close, kick soft, guitar strings audible.

SIGNATURE MOMENT: 'Told the waiter you're on your way. He knows.' at 0:42.

STATION FIT: 2 p.m., the slow middle of the afternoon. An acoustic-led track at 114 BPM that gives the ears a rest from synths.

EMOTIONAL ARC: Hopeful, patient, a little lonely, content anyway.
